double_sided_t_lap_or_corner.description: T-joint with double-sided fillet welds; lap and corner joints

single_sided_corner_or_t.description: Corner and T-joints with single-sided fillet welds

notes: Printed values apply when thinner thickness t is at least 0.6 times thicker thickness T.
For steel yield strength above 590 N/mm2, minimum weld legs are governed by manufacturing regulations.
For element thickness above 40 mm, minimum weld leg is determined by calculation.
When t < 0.6T, minimum weld leg is determined by calculation but may not exceed 1.2t.
